SELECT sessions.id, sessions.user_id, sessions.created_at, sessions.expires_at, sessions.last_activity_at, users.id AS id_1, users.name, users.email, users.password_hash 
FROM sessions INNER JOIN users ON sessions.user_id = users.id 
WHERE sessions.id = %(id_2)s
UPDATE sessions SET last_activity_at=%(last_activity_at)s WHERE sessions.id = %(sessions_id)s

SELECT rentals.id, rentals.listing_title, rentals.property_address, rentals.submitter_email, rentals.description, rentals.property_type, rentals.terms_accepted, rentals.manager_id 
FROM rentals ORDER BY rentals.id 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s, %(param_2)s
